This standard has largely been the result of collaboration among the coauthors

notes.zh:
交集：当 Agent 账户需要更细的验证钩子、执行钩子与模块清单时，ERC-6900 给出了比 7579 更重的模块化框架，适合做权限分层与策略插件。
适用范围：官方规范定义账户、验证模块、执行模块与 Hook 模块的接口，并允许「半模块化」账户；它不规定模块市场、审计标准或具体风控参数，模块是否可用仍取决于实现方。
未解决：与 ERC-7579 的互操作、模块升级与卸载的原子性、Hook 组合的冲突检测，以及账户抽象标准的最终收敛，都还没有定论。
notes.en:
Intersection: when an agent account needs finer validation hooks, execution hooks and module manifests, ERC-6900 offers a heavier modular framework than 7579, suited to permission layers and policy plugins.
Scope: the official spec defines account, validation-module, execution-module and hook-module interfaces and allows semi-modular accounts; it does not prescribe a module marketplace, audit standard or specific risk parameters — usability still depends on the implementer.
Open: interoperability with ERC-7579, atomicity of module upgrade/uninstall, conflict detection across hooks, and the eventual convergence of account-abstraction standards remain unsettled.
